name: Syntax-Aware Fill-In-the-Middle (SAFIM)
description: SAFIM is a benchmark for evaluating Large Language Models on syntax-aware code Fill-in-the-Middle tasks, focusing on completions of program structures such as code blocks and conditional expressions. It includes 17,720 examples from multiple programming languages and provides various prompt designs and syntax-aware post-processing techniques for fair comparison.
reputation: A recent research benchmark from the code-generation literature, but not yet a widely established community standard.
notes: Includes recent code submissions after April 2022 to minimize data contamination; provides a leaderboard and evaluation toolkit.
